title: Financial fact
description: GENERATED from schema/contracts/facts.py. The row type of the truth layer.

Derivation.description:
How a derived fact was computed. Required when source_kind is `derived`.

`formula` is a human-readable expression over the input metric names, e.g.
"op_cash_flow - capex". The verifier recomputes it and raises
IssueType.RECOMPUTE_MISMATCH when the stored value disagrees.

formula.description: Expression over input metrics, e.g. "op_cash_flow - capex".
formula.title: Formula

input_fact_ids.description: Every fact this value was computed from.
input_fact_ids.title: Input Fact Ids

computed_by.description: Module that computed it. calc/ is the only legitimate producer.
computed_by.title: Computed By

Derivation.title: Derivation

PeriodType.description: XBRL period shape. `duration` spans a range; `instant` is a point in time.
PeriodType.title: PeriodType

SourceKind.description: Where a FinancialFact came from. `derived` REQUIRES a Derivation.
SourceKind.title: SourceKind

Unit.description: Unit of a ValueObject. `fraction` is never a percent (0.25 means 25%).
Unit.title: Unit

metric.description: Canonical metric name, e.g. revenue, op_cash_flow. Not the XBRL tag.
metric.title: Metric

xbrl_concept.description: The us-gaap tag actually used, recorded because tags vary by filer.
xbrl_concept.title: Xbrl Concept

value.description: Full units. Null only for an unavailable fact.
value.title: Value

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for monetary units; null otherwise.
currency.title: Currency

scale.description: What the filing reported ("units"/"thousands"/"millions"). PROVENANCE ONLY - value is already normalized.
scale.title: Scale

period_start.description: Required for duration facts; must be null for instant.
period_start.title: Period Start

dimension.description: XBRL segment axis members. None means the CONSOLIDATED total (docs/sec-pitfalls.md: never sum dimensioned facts into a total).
dimension.title: Dimension

accession_number.description: Required for anything sourced from a filing.
accession_number.title: Accession Number

filed_at.description: Filing date. Point-in-time queries drop facts filed after as_of.
filed_at.title: Filed At

retrieved_at.description: When we fetched it. Always required.
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

source_location.description: Section id or XBRL fragment the value was read from.
source_location.title: Source Location

derivation.description: Required if and only if source_kind is `derived`.

superseded_by.description: Set when a later filing restated this value. Citing a superseded fact raises IssueType.SUPERSEDED_FACT.
superseded_by.title: Superseded By
